# Exercism

> > Exercism is a nonprofit coding platform offering practice exercises, mentoring, and track-based learning across 60+ programming languages.

Exercism provides a comprehensive learning environment with Practice Exercises, Concept Exercises, and human mentoring. The platform supports both online and CLI-based workflows, with tooling for track maintainers including representers, analyzers, and configlet. Key initiatives include the #12in23 challenge and the deprecated Teams Edition.

## Key Topics

- Practice Exercises
- Concept Exercises
- Mentoring
- Track building
- #12in23 challenge
- Swift programming
- Test-Driven Development (TDD)
- Online editor and CLI workflow
- Representers and analyzers
- Social mobility through programming education
- Community-driven learning
- Jeremy Walker (founder)
- Exercism v3
- Configlet tooling
- Problem-specifications

## Getting Started

- [About Exercism](https://exercism.org/about): Exercism's vision, mission, and strategy as a nonprofit coding platform
- [Solving exercises](https://exercism.org/docs/using/solving-exercises): Guide to solving exercises using online editor or CLI workflow
- [What is Test-Driven Development?](https://exercism.org/docs/using/solving-exercises/tdd): Guide to Test-Driven Development methodology for solving exercises

## Swift Track - Concepts & Exercises

- [Wordy in Swift on Exercism](https://exercism.org/tracks/swift/exercises/wordy): Swift exercise: parse word problems and evaluate arithmetic operations
- [Nested Functions in Swift](https://exercism.org/tracks/swift/concepts/nested-functions): Swift concept: nested functions, helper functions, and function scope
- [Value and reference types in Swift](https://exercism.org/tracks/swift/concepts/value-and-reference-types): Swift concept: value vs reference types, structs, classes, memory semantics
- [Higher Order Functions in Swift](https://exercism.org/tracks/swift/concepts/higher-order-functions): Swift concept: higher-order functions and functional programming patterns

## Mentoring

- [The Mentoring Mindset](https://exercism.org/docs/mentoring/mindset): Mentoring philosophy, mindset, and communication approach guidelines

## Track Building & Maintenance

- [Syllabus](https://exercism.org/docs/building/tracks/syllabus): Track syllabus design: Concept and Practice Exercises structure
- [Representers](https://exercism.org/docs/building/product/representers): Representer tooling for normalizing solutions and automated feedback
- [Deprecated Exercises](https://exercism.org/docs/building/tracks/deprecated-exercises): Guide to deprecating exercises and managing exercise status in config.json

## Tooling Reference

- [Exercism CLI](https://exercism.org/docs/building/tooling/cli): CLI tool reference for downloading exercises and running tests
- [configlet sync](https://exercism.org/docs/building/configlet/sync): Configlet sync command for syncing exercises with problem-specifications
